thread.title: Dow Movers: V, WBA

author: www.4-traders.com
title: Dow Movers: V, WBA
text:
In early trading on Monday, shares of Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 2.0%. Year to date, Walgreens Boots Alliance registers a 1.8% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is Visa (V), trading down 1.0%. Visa is showing a gain of 26.2% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Apple (AAPL), trading down 0.6%, and Coca-Cola (KO), trading up 0.9% on the day.
